caption: The drawing depicts a single object consisting of a curved metal blade attached to a cylindrical wooden handle. The blade is crescent-shaped, made of a dull, grayish-brown metal with visible speckling and textural irregularities that suggest rust or wear. The blade is broadest at its center and tapers towards both ends, forming a smooth curve that almost encloses a semicircle. The handle is a horizontal cylinder, colored a medium brown with visible wood grain texture, and is fastened to the ends of the blade with two small, round metallic elements at the points of connection. The background is plain and off-white, and there are no additional elements in the composition. The signature "N. Amantea" appears in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Chopping Knife
